description: Choose what to collect from the UK Open Food Facts catalogue and narrow it by nutrition scores, retailer, label or sort order.

barcodes.description: EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC or GTIN codes, or Open Food Facts product URLs (mode=byBarcode). One per item; duplicates are removed.
barcodes.title: Barcodes or product URLs

brandName.description: Brand name, taxonomy tag, or Open Food Facts brand URL. Examples: 'Tesco', 'Walkers', 'Heinz', 'Cadbury', 'Marks & Spencer'.
brandName.title: Brand (mode=byBrand)

categoryTag.description: Category name, taxonomy tag, or Open Food Facts category URL. Examples: 'crisps', 'cheeses', 'breakfast cereals', 'en:teas'.
categoryTag.title: Category (mode=byCategory)

ecoscoreGradeFilter.description: Keep products with this Green-Score (Eco-Score) grade or better. A+ is best; F is worst.
ecoscoreGradeFilter.title: Green-Score filter

includePrices.description: Attach the latest Open Prices record (GBP price, date, retailer and location) to each product. Prices are sparse and add one request per 100 products. The byOpenPrices mode always attaches the price it used for discovery.
includePrices.title: Include Open Prices

labelFilter.description: Keep products carrying this label. Examples: 'organic', 'vegan', 'gluten-free', 'fair-trade'. Works in every discovery mode.
labelFilter.title: Label filter

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to return. Values above 10,000 automatically use 92 created-time partitions because the search index caps a single query at 10,000 results.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape: a keyword search, the whole UK catalogue, a category, a brand, a retailer, exact barcodes, or products with a recorded GBP price.
enumTitles: Look up barcodes or product URLs
mode.title: Mode

novaGroupFilter.description: Keep only products in this NOVA processing group: 1 = unprocessed, 2 = processed ingredients, 3 = processed, 4 = ultra-processed.
novaGroupFilter.title: NOVA group filter

nutritionGradeFilter.description: Keep products with this Nutri-Score grade or better. Applies to discovery and barcode modes.
nutritionGradeFilter.title: Nutri-Score filter

searchQuery.description: Keyword used in any discovery mode. UK examples: 'cheddar', 'digestive biscuits', 'baked beans', 'tea bags'. Leave empty in browse mode to list products without a keyword.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result order. 'Best match' uses keyword relevance; browse modes default to most scanned.
sortBy.title: Sort by

storeTag.description: UK retailer name, tag, or Open Food Facts store URL. Examples: 'Tesco', 'Sainsbury's', 'Asda', 'Morrisons', 'Waitrose', 'Aldi', 'Lidl', 'Co-op', 'Iceland', 'Ocado'.
storeTag.title: Retailer (mode=byStore)

title: Open Food Facts UK Scraper Input
